data.name: MasterToggleHint
data.value: When enabled, the focused window is detected in real time: as soon as a document viewport is found, a linked canvas is created and follows document scrolling and zoom (currently supports Word and SumatraPDF)

data.name: WordHint
data.value: Track the document editing area and link annotation ink while writing in Word

data.name: SumatraPdfHint
data.value: Track the document rendering area and link annotation ink while writing in SumatraPDF (supports scroll following and auto long screenshots)

data.name: DebugToggleHint
data.value: Show the UI integration debug panel on the canvas layer: enable "Grab element with mouse" and click a target element to sample its UIA information (no need to write first)

data.name: DebugGrabHint
data.value: Grabbing: click a target element to sample its UIA (the click is not passed to the target app, and this app's own windows are excluded). Right-click or uncheck to exit

data.name: DebugGrabStatus
data.value: [Mouse grab] Active - click a target element to sample, right-click to exit

data.name: DebugNoCapture
data.value: (No element captured yet: enable "Grab element with mouse" and click a target element to sample)

data.name: RememberScrollPositionHint
data.value: Recorded only after ink is written; automatically restores the last position when the same document is reopened

data.name: AutoSaveInkHint
data.value: Saves canvas ink per document and automatically reloads it when the document is reopened

data.name: AutoLongScreenshotHint
data.value: When exiting annotation or unlinking, captures ink regions by scrolling: one block above the top and below the bottom stroke; larger gaps are split into multiple images
